answer: Entry is gated at one settlement wharf that auctions 40 tickets each epoch. A ticket needs a 400-unit bond locked eight epochs plus a unique custody receipt. An identity with no inbound settlement volume is tagged hollow and may hold only one ticket. A nightly scan paints the umber band on any cluster whose receipts share more than two hardware roots, or whose bids all clear from one wallet; those bonds slash in full and the receipts are revoked. A 500-clone farm then needs 200,000 units and 500 scarce tickets, so it stalls at the auction instead of flooding attestation.
